title: Medications and diagnoses cleared within a year
summary: Jordan tells of Medications and diagnoses cleared within a year, about 2010-2011 at Springville, New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was released from every single psychological diagnosises.

plain: A man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that around 2010 to 2011 in Springville, New York, he came off his medications. He says that within a year he was released from every psychological diagnosis he had been given. He tells it as part of his larger story, where it would mean his troubles came from what happened to him rather than from illness.
